conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club Standard is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups a year, priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Plus members also get an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both Standard and Plus members get $500 off any full system replacement.
I thought it was $149?
The facts don't show a $149 price for the maintenance plan.
The 2026 fee schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) lists Comfort Club at $189 per year for one system or $16.99 per month, and Comfort Club Plus at $269 per year.
The only $149 in our documents is the after-hours emergency dispatch fee for non-members (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv), which Comfort Club members don't pay.
If you're thinking of a single seasonal tune-up, it's $129 for non-members and included for members, per the same price book.
Hm. Okay.
Understood.

One thing that may explain the $149 you remember: Comfort Club members are locked at their enrollment price until their next renewal date, at which point the current price applies, per the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md).
The current price is $189 per year per system for Standard, with Plus at $269 per year per system.
The documents I have don't show an earlier $149 price.
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.

To file a warranty claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).
Since the unit was installed last year, it falls within the 2-year labor warranty that Meridian provides on all full system installations.
Comfort Club members at the time of installation receive an extended 5-year labor warranty instead (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand.
Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install, and registration is required for the full parts warranty term.
The manufacturer warranty covers the part only, so labor to replace a warranted part is billable after the Meridian labor warranty expires (Warranty Policy, Manufacturer parts warranty).
